question: 1 September marks the beginning of the meteorological _______ in the Southern Hemisphere.
solution:
The correct answer is __**spring.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **September Equinox** marks is the **first day of spring in the southern hemisphere.**

 
 
• It is known as the **Spring Equinox **in the **earth’s southern areas** (southern hemisphere).
 
 
 
• An **equinox occurs **twice in a year one is in March which is known as Spring Equinox and another is in September which is known as Autumn Equinox.
